caption: The drawing depicts a small, round stool with a cushioned top and four short, curved wooden legs. The seat cushion is covered in a deep, dark blue or purple fabric, embellished with an embroidered geometric pattern. The embroidery forms a diamond shape in the center, outlined in white and red, with additional small cross-like motifs inside and around the diamond, stitched in red, white, and orange thread. The edge of the seat is trimmed with a row of evenly spaced brass or gold-colored decorative tacks. The wooden base of the stool is light to medium brown and features a scalloped edge below the cushion, with the legs showing wood grain and a stylized, carved shape. The background of the drawing is a plain, solid off-white or cream color.
title: Footstool
